items.title: Friends Are Blessings Bracelet Card
items.alt: Two braided friendship bracelets overlap a peach card reading “FRIENDS ARE BLESSINGS” beside a stitched heart and daisy.
items.description: Pink-and-blue and green-and-yellow cords form different loops, finished with small heart charms and tasseled ends.

items.title: You Are a Blessing Bee
items.alt: A smiling yellow cartoon bee holds a cream sign reading “YOU ARE A BLESSING” and a white daisy.
items.description: Blue translucent wings, rounded shoes and long black antennae give the cheerful character a compact sticker silhouette.

items.title: Girl Praying Beside a Bedside Cabinet
items.alt: A cartoon girl with long braids and round glasses kneels with clasped hands beside a small lamp and closed book.
items.description: Lavender heart-pattern pajamas and an oval cushion distinguish the quiet pose alongside the complete two-drawer cabinet.

items.title: Boy Praying with a Plush Rabbit
items.alt: A red-haired cartoon boy in green striped pajamas sits cross-legged with clasped hands beside a plush rabbit.
items.description: A round patchwork mat and two star cushions frame the boy’s closed-eyed smile and bare feet.

items.title: Family Saying Grace Before a Meal
items.alt: Two cartoon adults and two children close their eyes around a table with a green casserole and bread rolls.
items.description: Different green, rust, blue and pink outfits distinguish the four figures around the cream cloth and checked table runner.

items.title: Praying Hands with a Cross and Lily
items.alt: Clasped hands in cream sleeves appear in front of a wooden Christian cross and a white lily.
items.description: Green stems pass behind the hands beneath the upright wood-grain cross, keeping the devotional symbol group compact.
